ROW.COLUMN: (ML/CU) Early Payoff or Paydown of a Credit Product

The payoff of a commercial loan facility, syndicated loan facility, mortgage, personal loan, or lease (all loans, loan facilities, or leases is referred to as loans) within a short period could enable an individual or business to move illegitimate funds into and out of the banking system in an apparently legitimate manner. To attempt to legitimatize funds, money launderers may look to take out a loan, and, within a short period, subsequently to: 1.Repay a significant portion of the loan 2.Repay the entire loan 3.Over pay the loan The rapid repayment of a loan enables money launderers to receive legitimate funds from the lending institution at loan closing and repay the loan with funds that may be illegitimate or whose source is difficult to determine. Further, if money launderer over pays the loan, a legitimate check is received from the lending institution for the over payment. This scenario looks for term loans (loans with set repayment schedules) that have significant pay downs, pay offs, or overpayments.

loan_vw as ( select l.LOAN_INTRL_ID , ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID , cu.CUST_INTRL_ID , cu.CUST_SEQ_ID , cu.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB as d_Effctv_Risk_Lvl , DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',l.LOAN_ORIG_FUNC_AM,l.LOAN_ORIG_BASE_AM) d_LOAN_ORIG_AM , l.LOAN_ACTL_PAYOFF_DT , l.LOAN_EXPTD_DUE_DT , case when cu.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB >= @Effctv_Risk_Cutoff_Lvl then 'HR' else 'RR' end as d_Overall_Risk -- calculating the days outstanding - How many days LOAN is already opened , (select JCurr_Dt from clndr_vw) - (F_TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(F_DATE_TO_CHAR(l.LOAN_ORIG_DT, 'J'), '0'))) as d_Days_Outstanding -- calculating how much loan remains to be paid in case of paydown - How many days left is till the end/maturity of Loan. , (F_TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(F_DATE_TO_CHAR(l.LOAN_EXPTD_DUE_DT, 'J'), '0'))) - (select JCurr_Dt from clndr_vw) as d_Remaining_Loan_Tenor -- picking up Early PO loans , case when l.LOAN_ACTL_PAYOFF_DT < l.LOAN_EXPTD_DUE_DT then 1 else 0 end as d_Early_Pay_Off
FROM @MINER@.ACCT ac, @MINER@.LOAN l, @MINER@.CUST cu where l.LOAN_INTRL_ID = ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID AND ac.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID = cu.CUST_INTRL_ID -- Exclude Test Accounts AND COALESCE(ac.TEST_ACCT_FL,'N') <> 'Y' -- Include specific account types only AND ac.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD IN ('LON') -- Include only Term loans AND l.LOAN_CLASS_CD = 'NRV' -- Exclude Exempt Customers AND cu.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Inlude Accout either from all or specifyed jurisdictions AND (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' OR cu.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) -- Include Loan Accounts Only AND (@All_Loan_Types = 'Y' OR l.LOAN_TYPE_CD IN (@Loan_Type_Cd)) -- Loam Sum > 0 AND DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',l.LOAN_ORIG_FUNC_AM,l.LOAN_ORIG_BASE_AM) > 0 --Bug34973020 --AND ((F_TO_NUMBER(COALESCE(F_DATE_TO_CHAR(l.LOAN_EXPTD_DUE_DT, 'J'), '0'))) - -- (select JCurr_Dt from clndr_vw)) >=(case when @HR_Remaining_Loan_Tenor < @RR_Remaining_Loan_Tenor then @RR_Remaining_Loan_Tenor else @HR_Remaining_Loan_Tenor end) ), -- all payments within lookback period (90 days not tunable) loan_sm as ( SELECT lb.LOAN_INTRL_ID --Interest paid before lookback period , SUM(case when f_trunc_date(lb.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT,'MM') = (select ED1_Date from clndr_vw) then lb.NB_PYMNT_CT else 0 end) AS Payment_Ct --last month Remaining balance in lookback period , SUM(case when f_trunc_date(lb.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT,'MM') = (select ED1_Date from clndr_vw) then DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',lb.RMNG_BAL_FUNC_AM,lb.RMNG_BAL_BASE_AM) else 0 end) AS RMNG_AM_LAST --previous month Remaining balance in lookback period , SUM(case when f_trunc_date(lb.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT,'MM') = (select ED2_Date from clndr_vw) then DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',lb.RMNG_BAL_FUNC_AM,lb.RMNG_BAL_BASE_AM) else 0 end) AS PREV_MTH_RMNG_AM , MAX(DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',lb.RMNG_BAL_FUNC_AM,lb.RMNG_BAL_BASE_AM)) AS MAX_LKBK_BAL_AM , MAX(lb.FUNC_CRNCY_CD) as FUNC_CRNCY_CD -- when it has value 1 it means only current month record was received , count(lb.LOAN_INTRL_ID) as record_ct FROM @MINER@.LOAN_SMRY_MNTH lb, loan_vw loan WHERE --20422198 lb.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT >= (select SD6_Date from clndr_vw) AND lb.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT <= (select ED1_Date from clndr_vw) AND loan.loan_intrl_id = lb.loan_intrl_id GROUP BY lb.LOAN_INTRL_ID -- check on Frequency having sum(case when f_trunc_date(lb.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT,'MM') = (select ED1_Date from clndr_vw) then lb.NB_PYMNT_CT else 0 end) > 0 ),
all_lns as ( SELECT loan_vw.CUST_INTRL_ID , loan_vw.CUST_SEQ_ID , loan_vw.d_Effctv_Risk_Lvl , loan_vw.ACCT_INTRL_ID , loan_vw.d_Overall_Risk -- calculating the days outstanding , loan_vw.d_Days_Outstanding -- calculating the percentage decrease , case when coalesce(loan_sm.MAX_LKBK_BAL_AM,0) <> 0 and record_ct > 1 then ((loan_sm.MAX_LKBK_BAL_AM - coalesce(loan_sm.RMNG_AM_LAST,0))* 100 / (loan_sm.MAX_LKBK_BAL_AM )) when coalesce(loan_vw.d_LOAN_ORIG_AM,0) <> 0 and record_ct = 1 then ((loan_vw.d_LOAN_ORIG_AM - coalesce(loan_sm.RMNG_AM_LAST,0))* 100 / (loan_vw.d_LOAN_ORIG_AM )) else 0 end as d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease --Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt = OutstandingBalanceBeforeLookback - Current MonthOutstandingBalance , case when record_ct > 1 then (coalesce(loan_sm.MAX_LKBK_BAL_AM,0) - coalesce(loan_sm.RMNG_AM_LAST,0)) when record_ct = 1 then (coalesce(loan_vw.d_LOAN_ORIG_AM,0) - coalesce(loan_sm.RMNG_AM_LAST,0)) else 0 end as d_Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt -- calculating how much loan remains to be paid in case of paydown , loan_vw.d_Remaining_Loan_Tenor -- picking the overpayed amount on the loan , case when (coalesce(loan_sm.RMNG_AM_LAST,0)) < 0 then (-1 * loan_sm.RMNG_AM_LAST) else 0 end as d_Loan_Overpayed_Amt , loan_vw.d_Early_Pay_Off --Enh 35845522 overpayment loan calculation , case when (coalesce(loan_sm.RMNG_AM_LAST,0)) < 0 then 1 else 0 end as d_Min_Overpayment_Ct -- percentage by which the outstanding balance must decrease since the last detection run for a loan , case when (coalesce(loan_sm.PREV_MTH_RMNG_AM,0)) <> 0 and record_ct > 1 then 100 * (loan_sm.PREV_MTH_RMNG_AM - coalesce(loan_sm.RMNG_AM_LAST,0))/ (loan_sm.PREV_MTH_RMNG_AM) when (coalesce(loan_vw.d_LOAN_ORIG_AM,0)) <> 0 and record_ct = 1 then 100 * (loan_vw.d_LOAN_ORIG_AM - coalesce(loan_sm.RMNG_AM_LAST,0))/ (loan_vw.d_LOAN_ORIG_AM) else 0 end as d_Loan_Prctg_Diff_Bal , loan_sm.Payment_Ct , loan_sm.FUNC_CRNCY_CD , loan_sm.record_ct , loan_sm.RMNG_AM_LAST , loan_sm.PREV_MTH_RMNG_AM , loan_sm.MAX_LKBK_BAL_AM , loan_vw.d_LOAN_ORIG_AM , loan_vw.LOAN_ACTL_PAYOFF_DT
FROM loan_vw, loan_sm WHERE loan_sm.LOAN_INTRL_ID = loan_vw.LOAN_INTRL_ID )
SELECT g.CUST_INTRL_ID, max(g.CUST_SEQ_ID) CUST_SEQ_ID, max(g.d_Days_Outstanding) d_Max_Days_Outstanding, -- calculating the decrease percentage of the all the accounts of the customer -- which includes both overpayment and payoff accounts max(g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease) AS d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease, sum(g.d_Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt) d_Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt, sum(g.d_Loan_Overpayed_Amt) d_Loan_Overpayed_Amt, sum(g.d_Min_Overpayment_Ct) d_Min_Overpayment_Ct, sum(g.d_Early_Pay_Off) + sum(case when (g.d_Overall_Risk = 'HR' AND (@HR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Prctg <= g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease AND g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease <= @HR_Max_Bal_Decrease_Prctg) AND g.d_Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt >= @HR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Amt AND g.LOAN_ACTL_PAYOFF_DT is null) or (g.d_Overall_Risk = 'RR' AND (@RR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Prctg <= g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease AND g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease <= @RR_Max_Bal_Decrease_Prctg) AND g.d_Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt >= @RR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Amt AND g.LOAN_ACTL_PAYOFF_DT is null) then 1 else 0 end) as d_Num_Early_PayOffs, max(g.d_Effctv_Risk_Lvl) d_Effctv_Risk_Lvl, max(g.d_Loan_Prctg_Diff_Bal) d_Loan_Prctg_Diff_Bal, g.d_Overall_Risk d_Overall_Risk, max(g.FUNC_CRNCY_CD) as FUNC_CRNCY_CD
FROM ALL_LNS g WHERE ( g.d_Overall_Risk = 'HR' AND g.d_Remaining_Loan_Tenor >= @HR_Remaining_Loan_Tenor AND (@HR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Prctg <= g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease AND g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease <= @HR_Max_Bal_Decrease_Prctg) AND g.d_Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt >= @HR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Amt ) OR ( g.d_Overall_Risk = 'RR' AND g.d_Remaining_Loan_Tenor >= @RR_Remaining_Loan_Tenor AND (@RR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Prctg <= g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease AND g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease <= @RR_Max_Bal_Decrease_Prctg) AND g.d_Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt >= @RR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Amt )
GROUP BY g.CUST_INTRL_ID, g.d_Overall_Risk
HAVING (( g.d_Overall_Risk = 'HR' AND MAX(g.d_Loan_Prctg_Diff_Bal) >=@HR_Min_Freq_Paydown_Prctg AND MAX(g.d_Days_Outstanding) <= @HR_Days_Outstanding AND SUM(g.d_Early_Pay_Off) + sum(case when (g.d_Overall_Risk = 'HR' AND (@HR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Prctg <= g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease AND g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease <= @HR_Max_Bal_Decrease_Prctg) AND g.d_Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt >= @HR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Amt AND g.LOAN_ACTL_PAYOFF_DT is null) then 1 else 0 end) >= @HR_Number_of_Early_Payoffs_Ct ) OR ( g.d_Overall_Risk = 'RR' AND MAX(g.d_Loan_Prctg_Diff_Bal) >=@RR_Min_Freq_Paydown_Prctg AND MAX(g.d_Days_Outstanding) <= @RR_Days_Outstanding AND SUM(g.d_Early_Pay_Off) + sum(case when (g.d_Overall_Risk = 'RR' AND (@RR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Prctg <= g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease AND g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease <= @RR_Max_Bal_Decrease_Prctg) AND g.d_Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt >= @RR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Amt AND g.LOAN_ACTL_PAYOFF_DT is null) then 1 else 0 end) >= @RR_Number_of_Early_Payoffs_Ct ) ) --28243230 and count(distinct g.ACCT_INTRL_ID) >= @Min_Acct_Ct
UNION
SELECT g.CUST_INTRL_ID, max(g.CUST_SEQ_ID) CUST_SEQ_ID, max(g.d_Days_Outstanding) d_Max_Days_Outstanding, -- calculating the decrease percentage of the all the accounts of the customer -- which includes both overpayment and payoff accounts max(g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease) AS d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease, sum(g.d_Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt) d_Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt, sum(g.d_Loan_Overpayed_Amt) d_Loan_Overpayed_Amt, sum(g.d_Min_Overpayment_Ct) d_Min_Overpayment_Ct, sum(g.d_Early_Pay_Off) + sum(case when (g.d_Overall_Risk = 'HR' AND (@HR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Prctg <= g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease AND g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease <= @HR_Max_Bal_Decrease_Prctg) AND g.d_Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt >= @HR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Amt AND g.LOAN_ACTL_PAYOFF_DT is null) or (g.d_Overall_Risk = 'RR' AND (@RR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Prctg <= g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease AND g.d_Loan_Prctg_Bal_Decrease <= @RR_Max_Bal_Decrease_Prctg) AND g.d_Loan_Bal_Decrease_Amt >= @RR_Min_Bal_Decrease_Amt AND g.LOAN_ACTL_PAYOFF_DT is null) then 1 else 0 end) as d_Num_Early_PayOffs, max(g.d_Effctv_Risk_Lvl) d_Effctv_Risk_Lvl, max(g.d_Loan_Prctg_Diff_Bal) d_Loan_Prctg_Diff_Bal, g.d_Overall_Risk d_Overall_Risk, max(g.FUNC_CRNCY_CD) as FUNC_CRNCY_CD
FROM all_lns g GROUP BY g.CUST_INTRL_ID, g.d_Overall_Risk
HAVING ( ( g.d_Overall_Risk = 'HR' AND MAX(g.d_Loan_Prctg_Diff_Bal) >=@HR_Min_Freq_Paydown_Prctg AND SUM(g.d_Min_Overpayment_Ct) >= @HR_Min_Overpayment_Ct --Enh 35845522 AND SUM(g.d_Loan_Overpayed_Amt) >= @HR_Min_Overpayment_Amt ) OR ( g.d_Overall_Risk = 'RR' AND MAX(g.d_Loan_Prctg_Diff_Bal) >= @RR_Min_Freq_Paydown_Prctg AND SUM(g.d_Min_Overpayment_Ct) >= @RR_Min_Overpayment_Ct --Enh 35845522 AND SUM(g.d_Loan_Overpayed_Amt) >= @RR_Min_Overpayment_Amt ) ) --28243230 and count(distinct g.ACCT_INTRL_ID) >= @Min_Acct_Ct

--ML_Early_PO_Credit_Products_fCU_SRule SELECT g.Cust_Intrl_Id , g.Cust_Seq_Id , g.Acct_Intrl_Id , g.Acct_Seq_Id , g.Clndr_Dt d_Data_Dump_Dt FROM (SELECT cu.CUST_INTRL_ID, cu.CUST_SEQ_ID, ac.ACCT_INTRL_ID, ac.ACCT_SEQ_ID,

WHERE -- Exclude Test Accounts COALESCE(ac.TEST_ACCT_FL,'N') <> 'Y' -- Include specific account types only AND ac.MANTAS_ACCT_BUS_TYPE_CD IN ('LON') -- Exclude Exempt Customers AND cu.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB <> -2 -- Include only Term loans AND lon.LOAN_CLASS_CD = 'NRV' -- Inlude Accout either from all or specifyed jurisdictions AND (@All_Jurisdictions_Fl = 'Y' OR cu.JRSDCN_CD IN (@Incl_Jurisdictions_Lst)) -- Include Loan Accounts Only AND (@All_Loan_Types='Y' OR lon.LOAN_TYPE_CD IN (@Loan_Type_Cd)) -- Loam Sum > 0 AND DECODE(@Curr_Type,'F',lon.LOAN_ORIG_FUNC_AM,lon.LOAN_ORIG_BASE_AM) > 0 -- PR 43254 Starts -- Ensure that a current month summary record exists to avoid alerting -- on loans that have had no activity. AND exists ( select 1 from @MINER@.loan_smry_mnth lsm where lsm.loan_intrl_id = lon.loan_intrl_id and f_trunc_date(lsm.MNTH_SMRY_START_DT,'MM') = (select f_trunc_date(kc.CLNDR_DT, 'MM') from @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL kc where kc.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and kc.MNTH_BNDRY_CD='ED1') ) -- PR 43254 Ends

or
